acceptanceResults: EN: The design specification records the same-repository boundary, independent Node frontend toolchain, cross-platform strategy, data flow, UI boundary, testing and CI plan in English, Japanese and Chinese. JA: design specification が同一 repository boundary、独立 Node frontend toolchain、cross-platform strategy、data flow、UI boundary、testing、CI plan を English、日本語、中文で記録する。ZH: 设计规格以英文、日语、中文记录同仓库边界、独立 Node 前端工具链、跨平台策略、数据流、UI 边界、测试和 CI 计划。

EN: The approved foundation will keep the frontend outside the Cargo member list and prevent direct imports from goods-domain, database, POS and provider code. JA: 承認後の foundation は frontend を Cargo member list の外に置き、goods-domain、database、POS、provider code の direct import を防ぐ。ZH: 获批后的基础工程将前端置于 Cargo member list 之外，禁止直接导入 goods-domain、数据库、POS 和 provider 代码。

EN: The specification makes browser-first support explicit, identifies the later Tauri desktop shell option and treats native mobile as a separate decision rather than an implied promise. JA: specification は browser-first support、将来の Tauri desktop shell option、native mobile を別 decision として明示し、暗黙の promise にしない。ZH: 规格明确 browser-first 支持、未来 Tauri desktop shell 选项，并把原生移动端作为单独决策，不作隐含承诺。

EN: No frontend implementation or external dependency is added before the written specification is reviewed by the human owner. JA: human owner が written specification を review する前に frontend implementation や external dependency を追加しない。ZH: 在项目负责人 review 书面规格前，不增加前端实现或外部依赖。
